scripts.build:wasm: mkdir -p ../../buildWASM && cd ../../buildWASM && emcmake cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=MinSizeRel .. && emmake make
scripts.build:all: npm run build:wasm && npm run build && npm run build:editor && npm run build:examples
scripts.build:examples: (cd examples/three && npm run build) && (cd examples/model-viewer && npm run build) && (cd examples/make-manifold && npm run build)
scripts.ci:all: npm ci && npm run ci:editor && npm run ci:examples
scripts.ci:examples: (cd examples/three && npm ci) && (cd examples/model-viewer && npm ci) && (cd examples/make-manifold && npm ci)
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:editor && npm run install:examples
scripts.install:examples: (cd examples/three && npm install) && (cd examples/model-viewer && npm install) && (cd examples/make-manifold && npm install)
scripts.docs: npm run docs:jsapi && npm run docs:jsuser
scripts.public: mkdir -p ./public && npm run public:docs && npm run public:editor && npm run public:examples
scripts.public:examples: (cd examples/three && npm run public) && (cd examples/model-viewer && npm run public) && (cd examples/make-manifold && npm run public)
